// NOTE: This file carries only what differs from the defaults in code. Every Postgres, Redis and MarketData value the API's appsettings.json restates is already the default on the options class itself, so repeating them here would be a second record of one fact that nothing would report as drifting — and a CLI-driven ingest running under a different retry or call-spacing policy than the scheduled pass is exactly the kind of divergence nobody would find. What a deployment actually varies arrives from the environment, from the same variables the API host reads, so the CLI operates the deployment it sits beside. No credential appears here. See .env.example.
// LOGGING: Quieter than the API on purpose. A command's answer is what it prints, and connection or query chatter on top of a table of findings is noise the operator has to read past. Every log line goes to standard error whatever its level, so a pipe reads the answer alone.
